map.输入水带直径、长度、流量与类型，按哈森-威廉（Hazen-Williams）公式: Enter the hose diameter, length, flow and type to compute the friction pressure loss using the Hazen-Williams formula.
map.水带沿程水头损失按 Hazen-Williams：h_f = 10.67·Q^1: Hose friction head loss by Hazen-Williams: h_f = 10.67·Q^1.852·L ÷ (C^1.852·D^4.87) (mH₂O, Q in m³/s, D in m); pressure drop ΔP = h_f×0.00980665 (MPa); velocity v = Q÷A.
map.哈森-威廉公式适用于常温清水、紊流态的消防水带沿程水头损失估算。: The Hazen-Williams formula is suitable for estimating the friction head loss of fire hose in normal-temperature clear water under turbulent flow.
map.C 值为海曾-威廉粗糙系数：衬里水带取 140，新型可达 150，旧水带应适当降: The C value is the Hazen-Williams roughness coefficient: 140 for lined hose, up to 150 for new hose, and it should be reduced appropriately for old hose.
map.结果未计入接口、弯头等局部损失（局部损失一般按沿程的 10%~20% 估算）。: The result does not include local losses at couplings and elbows (local losses are generally estimated at 10%-20% of the friction loss).
map.计算结果仅供灭火作战供水计算参考，实际应以现场压力表读数为准。: The result is for reference in firefighting water-supply calculation only; in practice the on-site pressure-gauge reading prevails.

map.火场供水时按水带口径、长度与流量估算干线沿程损失，反推泵出口压力需要多高才能保证: In fire water supply, estimate the friction loss of a main from the hose diameter, length and flow and back-calculate how high the pump outlet pressure must be to ensure the nozzle pressure.
map.长距离接力供水方案比选：比较 DN65 单干线与双干线并联的损失差异，决定铺设方: For long-distance relay supply, compare the loss of a single DN65 main versus two mains in parallel to decide the laying method.
map.器材选型与训练：验证更换新型聚氨酯衬里水带（C≈150）相比旧衬里能减少多少沿程: Equipment selection and training: verify how much friction loss is reduced by replacing an old lined hose with a new polyurethane-lined hose (C≈150).
map.DN65 水带 20m、6.5 L/s 的沿程损失: Friction loss of a DN65 hose, 20 m, 6.5 L/s
map.按默认参数（DN65、衬里水带 C=140、长度 20 m、流量 6.5 L/s: With the default parameters (DN65, lined hose C=140, length 20 m, flow 6.5 L/s): pipe velocity about 1.96 m/s, friction head loss 1.22 mH₂O (0.0119 MPa), about 0.014 MPa including estimated local losses, equivalent to about 0.06 MPa per 100 m. This means a 200 m main loses about 0.12 MPa along the way, so the pump outlet pressure must be raised accordingly to ensure the nozzle-end pressure.
map.为什么流量翻倍，损失增加这么多？: Why does the loss increase so much when the flow doubles?
map.沿程损失约与流量的 1.85 次方成正比：流量从 6.5 提到 13 L/s，损: The friction loss is approximately proportional to the 1.85 power of the flow: raising the flow from 6.5 to 13 L/s increases the loss about 3.6×. So the first measure to increase supply is to enlarge the hose diameter or lay mains in parallel, not simply to raise the pump pressure.
map.铺双干线能减多少损失？: How much loss do two mains in parallel reduce?
map.两条同规格干线并联时，每条只承担一半流量，损失约降至单干线的 30%，是长距离、: When two mains of the same specification are laid in parallel, each carries only half the flow and the loss drops to about 30% of a single main; this is standard practice for long-distance, high-flow supply, at the cost of doubling the laying work and hose consumption.
